parameters.query: INSERT INTO public.conversations (prospect_id, direction, sender, content, sent_at) SELECT p.id, 'inbound', 'prospect', $$ {{ $('Wait for Text Response').item.json.data.body }} $$, now() FROM public.prospects p WHERE p.telephone = '{{ $('Wait for Text Response').item.json.data.from }}' AND p.deleted_at IS NULL LIMIT 1;
